def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    glob=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_r=next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=glob)
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=glob and r!=line_r]
    out=[[glob]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[line_r]=[g[line_r][0]]*w
    minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells)
    below = line_r>minr or True
    # determine side: object is on side s of divider; keep side, become adjacent
    if minr>line_r:  # object below divider
        for r,c in cells: out[line_r+1+(r-minr)][c]=g[r][c]
        obj_end=line_r+1+(maxr-minr)

    else:            # object above divider: line, object, divider

        for r,c in cells: out[line_r-1-(maxr-r)][c]=g[r][c]
        obj_top=line_r-1-(maxr-minr)

def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def find_divider(grid):
    """The row index and color of the full row of a single non-background color."""
    bg = background(grid)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg:
            return r, row[0]
    return None

def object_cells(grid, bg):
    """List of (r, c) cells whose color is not the background."""
    return [(r, c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] != bg]

def blank(grid, bg=None):
    """A grid of the same size filled only with the background color."""
    bg = bg if bg is not None else background(grid)
    return [[bg] * len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))]

def paint(grid, cells, color):
    """Set each (r, c) cell in the list to color (mutates and returns the grid)."""
    for r, c in cells:
        grid[r][c] = color
    return grid

def fill_row(grid, r, color):
    """Set the whole row r to color."""
    grid[r] = [color] * len(grid[0])
    return grid

def translate_rows(grid, cells, dr):
    """Shift the given (r, c) cells down by dr rows."""
    return [(r + dr, c) for r, c in cells]

def place_object_below_divider(grid, line_color=8):
    """Pull the non-background object to sit adjacent below its divider row, then draw a full line of line_color just beyond the object."""
    bg = background(grid)
    lr, _ = find_divider(grid)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, c in object_cells(grid, bg) if r != lr]
    out = blank(grid, bg)
    fill_row(out, lr, grid[lr][0])
    minr = min(r for r, c in cells); maxr = max(r for r, c in cells)
    if minr > lr:  # object below the divider: keep side, move adjacent
        for r, c in cells:
            out[lr + 1 + (r - minr)][c] = grid[r][c]
        fill_row(out, lr + 1 + (maxr - minr) + 1, line_color)
    else:          # object above the divider: line, object, divider
        for r, c in cells:
            out[lr - 1 - (maxr - r)][c] = grid[r][c]
        fill_row(out, lr - 1 - (maxr - minr) - 1, line_color)
    return out
